package.description: DeepSeek dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的桌面客户端，托盘常驻并自动拉起 dsh Web UI。

en-US.description: A desktop client for DeepSeek dsh (DeepSeek Harness) with a resident system tray and auto-launched Web UI.
en-US.longDescription: DeepSeek Desktop is a desktop client for DeepSeek dsh (DeepSeek Harness): it stays resident in the system tray, offers a three-way choice when closing, starts dsh automatically on launch and navigates to its Web UI. The app and the dsh package upgrade independently. Built with Tauri v2 and React; requires Node.js 22.19+ (with npm).

zh-CN.description: DeepSeek dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的桌面客户端，托盘常驻并自动拉起 dsh Web UI。
zh-CN.longDescription: DeepSeek Desktop 是 DeepSeek dsh（DeepSeek Harness）的桌面客户端：托盘常驻、关闭时提供三选对话框，启动时自动拉起 dsh 并导航到其 Web UI。应用自身与 dsh 包各自独立升级。基于 Tauri v2 + React 构建，需要 Node.js 22.19+（含 npm）。
zh-CN.name: DeepSeek Desktop
